posts.title: Is My Dependence on Frontier Labs Replaceable?
posts.description: Replacing my dependence on frontier labs was easier than I expected, with more control over my data and little change to how I work.

posts.title: When Confidence Feels Like Understanding
posts.description: Reading an agent's recommendation, realising I haven't understood it, and deciding whether this is a moment to delegate or to learn.

posts.title: Everyone Gets Bespoke Software
posts.description: Far enough up the stack, a harness stops being a general way of building software and becomes a machine that knows how to build one kind of system, in one domain. That is where the configuration layer of enterprise platforms and configurable SaaS ends up, and why bespoke stops meaning from scratch.
